name: EPIC 212375638

text.card: A red giant 3,170 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.75 solar masses and 8.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,180 K at its surface.
